title: Duplicate Properties panel — consolidate into the right pane (with Library), remove the bottom one
description:
USER-REPORTED layout bug: there are TWO separate Properties panels in the editor.

MOUNT LOCATIONS (both in packages/authoring-ui/src/Shell.tsx):
(a) RIGHT-PANE Properties (the GOOD one) — shares the right dock with Library via a Library|Properties tab switch:
    - tab button: Shell.tsx:3511-3516 (onClick setRightTab("properties"))
    - rendered content: Shell.tsx:3554-3655 — a composed PanelGroup view (Transform / Instance / Component Inspector / Align / Info). NOTE: this branch does NOT mount <PropertiesPanel>; it inlines PanelGroups. Library is the sibling branch at 3535-3553. They coexist as tabs in one right dock.
(b) BOTTOM-DOCK Properties (the EXTRA to remove) — a 4th tab in the collapsible bottom dock (Actions|Sound|Properties|Output):
    - tab registry entry: BOTTOM_TABS at Shell.tsx:471  { id: "properties", label: "Properties" }
    - mount: Shell.tsx:3468-3482  {bottomTab === "properties" && <PropertiesPanel .../>}  (this IS the imported PropertiesPanel component, Shell.tsx:68)
    - supporting type: BottomTab union in packages/authoring-ui/src/store/uiStore.ts:26 includes "properties".

DESIRED END STATE: a SINGLE Properties panel living in the RIGHT-pane dock shared with the Library tab. Remove the bottom-dock Properties tab + its mount. Library must still coexist in the right pane.

ROOT CAUSE / why there are two: two INDEPENDENT mounts added in DIFFERENT commits, not one dock config listing Properties twice.
 - Right-pane Library|Properties tab pair: commit 4b4e4cf2 "initial progress" (2026-06-09 15:03).
 - Bottom-dock Properties tab + <PropertiesPanel> mount + BOTTOM_TABS entry: commit 3bd8ab1f "feat(0712): resizable panes, collapsible bottom tabs, Actions panel consistency" (2026-06-09 20:52). Task 0712 made the bottom dock tabbed (Timeline|Actions|Sound|Properties|Output) and ADDED a Properties tab there that duplicates the pre-existing right-pane Properties.

VERDICT: LEFTOVER/REGRESSION from the 0712 bottom-dock-tabs refactor (SHA 3bd8ab1f). The right-pane Properties (4b4e4cf2) is the original/canonical one. NOT the PanelGroup re-theme (6dfe678/1258).

FIX DIRECTION: remove the bottom Properties mount and its dock-registry entry:
  1. delete the BOTTOM_TABS entry at Shell.tsx:471;
  2. delete the {bottomTab === "properties"} block at Shell.tsx:3468-3482;
  3. remove "properties" from the BottomTab union (uiStore.ts:26) and check any setBottomTab("properties")/lastBottomTabRef defaults still resolve to a valid tab;
  4. if <PropertiesPanel> import becomes unused after removal, drop the Shell.tsx:68-69 import.
Ensure the right-pane Library|Properties tab pair (Shell.tsx:3503-3655) remains intact and Library still coexists there.

Priority: medium (layout/UX, user-reported). Investigated at HEAD a87cbff87c7debdbca5bdcea8d08e4ee6ebcaa22.
